rules.description: When pincode is not sent, latitude and longitude are both required (the pincode is derived from them).
sort_by and gender are accepted only when service_name is inclinic_consultation.
api_customer_id is required when sort_by is visited_before.
address is required when appointment_type is home_collection.
Each customer needs its own api_customer_id.
Each customer's dob must be on or before the same date one year ago (members must be at least 1 year old).
Home collection only. address_line_one, address_line_two, city, state and country must not contain a 6-digit pincode other than address.pincode.
When address is sent for a home-collection booking, address_line_one, address_line_two, city, state and country must not contain a 6-digit pincode other than address.pincode.
When address is sent for a home-collection appointment, address_line_one, address_line_two, city, state and country must not contain a 6-digit pincode other than address.pincode.
When pincode is not sent, latitude and longitude are both required (the pincode is derived from them).
api_customer_id is required when sort_by is visited_before.
Each customer needs its own api_customer_id.
Each customer's dob must be on or before the same date one year ago (members must be at least 1 year old).
appointment_date_time must be later than now (a time without an offset is read as IST).
appointment_date_time is required unless priority_consultation is true.
Unless priority_consultation is true, appointment_date_time must be later than now (a time without an offset is read as IST).
Each customer needs its own api_customer_id.
Each customer's dob must be on or before the same date one year ago (members must be at least 1 year old).
appointment_date_time must be later than now (a time without an offset is read as IST).
At least one file; every file entry needs both a non-blank name and a value.
Each file must be PDF, JPEG or PNG (extension pdf, jpg, jpeg or png) and not password-protected.
customers must contain exactly one customer.
files[] must contain at least one file.
Each file at most 10 MB, with content type image/jpeg, image/png or application/pdf.
dob must not be after today.
Send at least one change (products, address or address_id, prescription_urls or prescription_files, remove_prescription_ids, fulfillment_type or selected_chemist_id).
Send either address or address_id, not both.
selected_chemist_id is required when fulfillment_type is store_pickup (or the cart is already store pickup and fulfillment_type is not sent).
Each product id may appear only once.
A new address needs pincode or zip_code.
Each prescription file must be smaller than 7 MB and be PDF, PNG or JPEG; files fetched from prescription_urls must also be smaller than 7 MB and served as application/pdf, image/png or image/jpeg.
A new address's line1, line2, city, state and country must not contain a 6-digit pincode other than its pincode.
selected_chemist_id is required when selected_delivery_option is store_pickup (and must match the store saved on the cart).
partner_collected_amount must be a decimal greater than 0 (it must also equal the order's amount_to_collect).
Send api_customer_id or customer_id.
Send api_customer_id or customer_id.
At most 250 rows in employees and dependants together.
Each employee needs a non-blank email or employee_code.
Each dependant needs guardian_email, or company_id together with guardian_employee_code.
date_of_birth (when not blank) must not be after today.
At most 250 rows in employees and dependants together.
Each employee needs email, or company_id together with employee_code.
Each dependant needs api_customer_id, dependent_code or mobile_number.
At most 250 entries in employees and dependants together.
